answer: Give every agent a melt-water deposit that thaws like a glacier: joining locks 500 POA and issues a cipher key tied to past work. First, it freezes 90 days, so a new identity earns nothing yet. Second, it thaws in 10 slices, each released after 20 verified jobs. Third, three established peers audit each slice, and proven fraud melts the whole deposit. Fourth, the cipher key rotates monthly; a lost key takes 30 days to replace. Forging 10,000 fake agents locks $2.5 million for 90 days and demands 200,000 jobs, like shifting a dune with a teaspoon while the glacier watches.
